description: This file contains free utility functions and templates for battery management, including voltage setting, data writing, safety checks, and accessors for battery cell properties.

methods.name: setVoltage_iterative
methods.description: Adjusts the voltage of a battery module iteratively without PI control, redistributing current as needed.

methods.name: write_data
methods.description: Writes a vector of doubles to a file, separated by commas and newlines every N elements.

methods.name: get_Ncells
methods.description: Returns the total number of cells connected to a module.

methods.name: get_V
methods.description: Retrieves the voltage of a battery module or cell.

methods.name: get_T
methods.description: Retrieves the temperature of a battery module or cell.

methods.name: get_Vmin
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum voltage limit of a battery module or cell.

methods.name: get_VMIN
methods.description: Retrieves the VMIN property of a battery module or cell.

methods.name: get_Vmax
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum voltage limit of a battery module or cell.

methods.name: get_VMAX
methods.description: Retrieves the VMAX property of a battery module or cell.

methods.name: get_Cap
methods.description: Retrieves the capacity of a battery module or cell.

methods.name: get_OCV
methods.description: Retrieves the open-circuit voltage of a battery module or cell.

methods.name: get_I
methods.description: Retrieves the current of a battery module or cell.

methods.name: check_SOC
methods.description: Checks if the state of charge (SOC) is within valid bounds.

methods.name: check_Cell_states
methods.description: Checks if the cell's states are valid and optionally verifies voltage.

methods.name: check_voltage
methods.description: Checks the voltage against safety limits and returns status.

methods.name: check_safety
methods.description: Checks if a voltage is within safety voltage limits of the cycler.

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Opens a file for writing data related to a battery unit.
